cands.name: Randy Fine
cands.bio: Republican, U.S. House since April 2025 (won special election after Mike Waltz resigned). Harvard graduate; former casino executive (Harrah's, Greektown Casino CEO). Florida House 2016-2024, Florida Senate Nov 2024-Mar 2025. Committees: Education and Workforce; Foreign Affairs.
cands.local_ties: District 6 now covers Flagler, Lake, Marion, Putnam, St. Johns and Volusia counties (per Fox 35). Wikipedia reports he owns a home in Melbourne Beach (Brevard County), which is outside the new District 6; critics have raised that residency point (Florida law does not require a House member to live in the district).

record.text: Committees (119th Congress): Education and Workforce; Foreign Affairs. Member of the Freedom Caucus and Republican Study Committee.

Bills/actions listed on Wikipedia: June 2025 bill to designate CAIR a terrorist organization; Oct 2025 'No Sharia Act'; Jan 2026 Greenland Annexation and Statehood Act; 2026 K-12 AI Literacy and Readiness Act (per ClickOrlando voter guide).

ClickOrlando voter guide: he requested $3 million for the Rolling Acres Housing Expansion in Lady Lake; supports eliminating the Education Department and school choice; supports finishing the border wall and mass deportations.

Won the Aug 18, 2026 Republican primary with about 57.6% over Dan Bilzerian, Aaron Baker and Charles Gambaro (per Wikipedia results table; Wikipedia and ClickOrlando give slightly different vote counts).

controversies.text: Repeated posts and statements about Muslims and Gaza have drawn condemnation, including from Democratic leaders and the American Jewish Committee (e.g. July 2025 'starve away' Gaza post; July 2025 attack on Rep. Ilhan Omar; Feb 2026 'dogs vs Muslims' post; Apr-May 2026 remarks saying Armenians should not serve in Congress). The posts are documented; Fine has defended many of them.

Aug 16, 2026: video from a homeowner's Ring camera in Ormond Beach shows Fine going through a mailbox while canvassing. His office confirmed it was him. Federal law bars non-postal workers from tampering with mailboxes; the homeowner reportedly declined to press charges and no federal charges were reported.

Wikipedia lists earlier state-era items: April 2023 Florida Ethics Commission found probable cause he threatened state funding over a personal dispute; Oct 2024 held in contempt of court for an obscene gesture during a hearing.

endorsements.text: Endorsed by President Trump, the NRA Political Victory Fund and AIPAC per Wikipedia's district page and his Wikipedia biography. (The New Republic reported in July 2025 that AIPAC had dropped him; AIPAC disputed that.)

cands.gaps: Owner's five sources were NOT searched (web-search budget ran out before those queries could be run). No verified outside-spending or donor figures found. Votes_state for his Florida legislature years not collected (not requested). Trump endorsement date/article (Florida Politics) could not be opened (paywall).
